sourceFacts: Myelin supports efficient conduction along peripheral nerve fibres.
Immune-mediated damage to myelin can slow or block conduction.
prompt:

Anatomical clarity before decoration. Never photorealistic skin, glossy blood, wet flesh, fat lobules, scary faces, chunky 3D tissue blocks, or a fake scan. Only exact requested labels, clean legible short text. Footer 'Educational schematic'. No watermark, logos or attribution in the pixels. Top 'Intact myelin': exactly four simple teal sleeve segments around axon with small exposed gaps labelled 'Node'; above axon broad navy curved arrows jump from gap to gap toward right. Label one top sleeve 'Myelin'. Top long rightward arrow 'Signal direction'. Title 'Myelin and peripheral nerve conduction'.
